architecture: Deterministic RuleGateCenterThenCommit backbone + frozen BC-v1 visual servo blended only in VISUAL_ALIGN (weight ramped by visual confidence, capped 0.55). Backbone is sole authority in SEARCH/APPROACH/COMMIT/VERIFY_EXIT/ADVANCE.
onboard_inputs: received beacons, FrontCamera, depth/IMU/DVL, controller-local state; no referee/world/gate pose.
conclusion: The hybrid completes multi-gate (two-gate 2/2, three-gate 2/2) and a full circuit current-free (horseshoe 2/2, 12/12 gates, 0 collisions/oob) where BC-v1 alone completes 0/8 multi-gate. The learned visual servo is integrated without regressing multi-gate reliability, because the deterministic backbone owns the inter-gate navigation and gate passage.
